## Why We Are the Best
ME Pilates Institute offers Dehradun's only comprehensive equipment Pilates and specialty suspension Yoga classes. Our state-of-the-art studio features exclusive equipment like Reformers, Cadillacs, Wunda Chairs, Aerial silks, and Bungee harnesses, led by highly qualified, 500-hour certified founders Palak Sharma and Arya Tyagi.
